clarity_findings.claim: The sentence "Your [[capital]] starts with {rate:system_capital_base_production|production} instead." renders as "Your Your capital starts with 100 production per tick instead."
clarity_findings.problem: The `capital` alias resolves to the heading "Your capital" on star-systems (its default link label per §3.1), and the prose already has a leading "Your" before the link, so the word doubles. Confirmed in both the --text render ("Every system starts with 40 production per tick before bonuses. Your Your capital starts with 100 production per tick instead.") and the --page HTML (`Your Your capital starts with ...`). This is the must_fix category "a link whose label reads wrong in its sentence."
clarity_findings.fix: Drop the leading "Your" and let the link's own label carry it: "Every system starts with {rate:system_base_production|production} before bonuses. [[capital]] starts with {rate:system_capital_base_production|production} instead." (renders "...Your capital starts with 100 production per tick instead."). Alternatively give the link an explicit non-duplicating label.
